messages:
Priya (CS): Heads up — EmberHealth showing a steep usage drop since Wed. ~72% fewer tokens and active seats are down. Procurement pinged for an RFP; this looks like a renewal-risk signal. Need quick triage.

Noah (AM): Noted. They swapped ML lead last week (Olivia left). I intro'd new lead but no reply yet. Any telemetry or error traces?

Ava (CSM): I spoke to the champion (Marcus) yesterday — he said their infra team paused calls after seeing integration errors. Asked SE to investigate.

Miguel (SE): Quick check from our side: spike in prefix cache misses + 502/504 errors on /ingest webhook around 2026-03-18 14:03 UTC. Example log:
```
ERROR org.redwood.ingest - webhook timeout 504 ctx=ctx-9df3 - upstream reset
WARN org.redwood.batch - batch size 512 dropped after proxy reject
```
Looks like their proxy started rejecting larger batches after an internal config change. No rolling deploys on our infra.

enablement-bot: Alert: account EmberHealth — usage drop >50% over 7d. Playbook suggestions: "silent-adoption" and "dedicated-trial-offer".

Priya (CS): Proposed plan: (1) immediate dev sync with EmberHealth infra + @Miguel to validate proxy config (tomorrow 10am PT), (2) offer 30-day Dedicated trial to demonstrate isolation and steady throughput, (3) schedule a QBR with new ML lead + procurement to reframe ROI and the production story. Who owns outreach? :thinking_face:

Noah (AM): I can own procurement outreach and draft the trial terms. I'll email procurement today and cc Priya. Miguel, can you confirm availability for the dev sync?

Miguel (SE): Available tomorrow 10am PT. I'll prepare a short runbook and a simple repro curl to validate proxy behavior:
```
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.example/v1/prefix -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"batch": [{"input": "test"}], "metadata": {"size": 1}}' -v
```
That will surface proxy limits quickly.

Ava (CSM): I'll draft a one-page enablement checklist + quickstart links for Marcus and the new ML lead; I can try to re-engage the champion before the dev sync.

Priya (CS): Action items and owners: Miguel (SE) — repro + runbook (tomorrow); Noah (AM) — procurement outreach & trial terms (today); Ava (CSM) — champion touch and enablement doc (today); Priya — draft renewal note and update risk score. Reconvene in this thread after the sync. :thumbsup:
